text: Cadet! The stores truck is here. We load everything with the provision crane.
With the crane? Can I help?
Yes. I'm in the crane, you're the signalman. You watch the load and give me the signals.
Wait a moment, Rolando. How heavy is the first pallet?
About one point five tonnes, Chief.
Diego, read the marking on the jib. What's the SWL?
SWL two tonnes.
Good. One point five is fine. But the drinks pallet is two point five. We can't lift that in one go. Split it.
No problem, Chief. Cadet, check the sling and the shackle on the hook.
Sling on the hook, shackle pin tight. Ready.
OK. Give me the signals.
Hoist slowly… Stop! Lower… lower… Stop. Load on deck.
Careful! My eggs are in that pallet!
Relax, Mario. Cadet, now we lash it. Lashings on, turnbuckles tight.
Lashings on, turnbuckles tight. Nothing moves.
Show me the hook.
Where's the pad eye?
Where's the snatch block?
Show me the thimble.
Show me the turnbuckle.
Where's the jib?
This pallet is one point two tonnes.
This crane can lift two tonnes. The pallet is three tonnes.
Cadet, the load is ready. Give me the signal.
Diego, what's the SWL of the crane?
The drinks pallet is two point five tonnes. One lift, OK?
Is the pallet secure?
Rolando, what are you lifting now?
I'm lifting the vegetables. One tonne.
